_why: Cost guardrails G·2 (docs/plans/2026-11-11-guardrails-infra-a2.md). The source of truth for the frata project's Vercel Firewall; entered by hand in the dashboard (2026-11-11: the REST API answers 404 "config not found" for this project even after Bot Protection and a custom rule were published, so it cannot be applied or read back by API). Bypass rules run before the managed rulesets: Shiprocket, Mux and WhatsApp are not Vercel-verified bots (frata-integrations § Vercel platform, 2026-11-11). Bot Protection and AI Bots start in LOG; challenge only after a day of logs shows no real shopper, preview or webhook caught. Previous config before 2026-11-11: none (GET config/active answered 404). 2026-11-11 (A2·2): the beacon's rate limit added first, and the link-preview bypass kept off /api/. 2026-11-15 (V1 Storefront API): the API host's path rule, rate rule and kill switch added first.

rules.name: Storefront API: refuse any other path
rules.description: V1 Storefront API (plan docs/plans/2026-11-15-v1-storefront-api.md § SA0·1; unit-economics review 2026-11-15). On the API host only the version's own paths can start a function: a bad key shape, page or handle is denied at the edge (a custom rule: free). Keep the regex in step with src/domains/tenancy/host.ts apiRewrites and the routes under src/app/api/storefront/ (a test holds it: src/domains/storefront-api/__tests__/waf.test.ts).

rules.name: Storefront API: rate limit per IP
rules.description: V1 Storefront API: one rate rule on the API host, 600 a minute per IP (partner builds and hosted sites share outbound IPs; unit-economics review 2026-11-15). The app's own limits (misses, test keys, search) fail closed behind it. Priced per allowed request (about $0.55 a million, an estimate: recheck before go-live).

rules.name: Storefront API: kill switch (off)
rules.description: V1 Storefront API: made in advance and left OFF. Turn it on to deny the whole API host (abuse, a cost spike, an incident): partner sites keep serving their stale pages, shops and checkout stay up. Turning it off restores the API at once.

rules.name: Rate limit the visit beacon
rules.description: A2·2 (security review 2026-11-11 HIGH-2): /api/shop/e is public, so forged beacons are capped per IP before they become invocations. First, so no bypass rule can skip it. 120 a minute per IP, as the route's own cap; a real visit sends a few. Priced per allowed request: about $0.55 a million (speed review estimate, 2026-11-11; recheck on the WAF pricing page before go-live), so cents a month at 20 shops.

rules.name: Bypass webhooks and crons
rules.description: Providers that aren't verified bots (Shiprocket, Mux) must always reach /api/webhooks; Vercel Cron reaches /api/cron. Each route checks its own signature or cron secret.

rules.name: Bypass link previews (WhatsApp, Telegram)
rules.description: Link previews of shops shared on WhatsApp and Telegram (unverified bots). The dashboard offers no regex for User Agent, so two 'contains' conditions joined by OR. A user agent can be faked; this skips bot rules only, not DDoS mitigation. Each condition also needs a path that doesn't start with /api/ (security review 2026-11-11 HIGH-2: a faked 'WhatsApp' user agent must never skip the beacon's rate limit).
